item.title: Vibrato by Sospiro Perfumes – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Sospiro Perfumes
Type:
Price: 6.49 - 44.99 (5 variants)

Overview

Vibrato is a bright, polished unisex Eau de Parfum: sparkling grapefruit and bergamot lifted by jasmine and magnolia, settling into fresh ginger, green herbs and a soft powdery heart. The dry-down is clean and refined, with musk, cedar, amber, patchouli and orris giving it an elegant, slightly creamy finish.

Composed by Christian Provenzano and launched in 2022, it is the genuine original from the Sospiro Collection, and the fragrance a whole wave of citrus-and-ginger tributes is built around. Try the real thing in a 1ml sample before committing to a full bottle.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Grapefruit, Bergamot, Jasmine, Magnolia
Middle: Ginger, Herbal Notes, Powdery Notes
Base: Musk, Cedar, Amber, Patchouli, Orris Root

Best for

Season: Spring, summer and early fall · Wear it: office, everyday · For: men and women

item.title: Club de Nuit Intenso Fuego by Armaf – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Armaf
Type:
Price: 2.49 - 62.99 (5 variants)

Overview

Club de Nuit Intenso Fuego is a 2026 Eau de Parfum from Armaf's Club de Nuit line, built around a fire-and-flamenco theme. It opens bright and juicy with mandarin, grapefruit, black currant, plum and a charred pineapple accord sharpened by pink pepper, then turns aromatic with lavender, geranium and a sunny floral heart.

The drydown warms into honey, tonka, vanilla and cedar over clean white musk, so it moves from fresh and fruity to sweet and woody as it wears.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Mandarin, Black Currant, Bergamot, Plum, Grapefruit, Pink Pepper, Terebinth, Charred Pineapple
Middle: Lavender, Geranium, Solar Flowers
Base: Cedar, Vanilla, Patchouli, White Musk, Ambrettolide, Honey, Tonka Bean

Best for

Season: Spring, summer and fall · Wear it: everyday, nights out · Time: day and night

item.title: Mahd Al Dhahab Extrait by Arabiyat Prestige – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Arabiyat Prestige
Type:

Overview

Mahd Al Dhahab Extrait is the Extrait de Parfum version of Arabiyat Prestige's Mahd Al Dhahab, a warm woody-amber scent with a juicy red-berry and citrus opening. Ginger, juniper and clary sage give it an aromatic, gently spiced lift before tea and incense lead into a smooth base of vanilla, amber, sandalwood and guaiac wood.

It reads sweet, polished and grown-up, and it is often compared to BornToStandOut Drunk Lovers.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Red Fruits, Berries, Bergamot, Ginger, Juniper Berries, Lemon, Grapefruit, Petitgrain
Middle: Ginger, Clary Sage, Floral Notes, Tea, Cypress, Incense
Base: Vanilla, Amber, Sandalwood, Guaiac Wood, Ambroxan, Musk, Patchouli

Best for

Season: Fall and winter · Wear it: date night, nights out · Time: evening

Overview

Hawas Ice Freeze is a 2026 Eau de Parfum from Rasasi that takes the Hawas Ice line somewhere colder and brighter. A sharp citrus opening of bergamot, orange and mandarin meets an icy blast of mint and a spark of ginger, with lily of the valley adding a clean, airy lift. The dry-down is a soft, skin-close blend of musk, sandalwood and ambergris, a cool and polished citrus scent often compared to Louis Vuitton Afternoon Swim.

Base: Musk, Sandalwood, Ambergris

Overview

Momento Liquid Gold is a rich, sweet unisex Extrait de Parfum from Riiffs, the 2026 gold-edition follow-up to Momento. Juicy blackberry and a sparkling burst of blood orange, tangerine and mandarin open onto a warm heart of praline and roasted tonka bean, softened by Pomarose and Mahonial. It settles into a smooth, ambery-woody base of Akigalawood, cedar and white musk that lingers for hours.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Blackberry, Tangerine, Blood Orange, Bergamot, Mandarin
Middle: Tonka Bean, Praline, Pomarose, Mahonial
Base: Akigalawood, Sylkolide, Cedar, White Musk

Best for

Overview

Atlas Canyon is a 2026 flanker of Lattafa's Atlas: a bright, dry Eau de Parfum that opens with a sparkling burst of bergamot and lemon sharpened by fresh ginger, lifts into airy lily of the valley and sea notes, and dries down to clean ambroxan over earthy patchouli, oakmoss and soft musk. Lattafa files it as hesperidic ambery; reviewers describe it as a fresher, airier, less spicy take on the citrus-ginger style of Louis Vuitton Symphony.

Top: Ginger, Bergamot, Lemon
Middle: Lily of the Valley, Sea Notes
Base: Ambroxan, Patchouli, Oakmoss, Musk

item.description:

Type:

Overview

Atlas Glacial Valley is a 2026 flanker of Lattafa's Atlas, and despite the icy name it wears warm: an Eau de Parfum that opens on juicy pineapple, green fig and a cool flick of mint, turns floral and faintly salty with jasmine and sea salt over patchouli, then settles into a sweet, mossy base of amber, vanilla and musk. Lattafa calls it an oriental marine; the pineapple-over-patchouli-and-moss structure puts it in the same fruity, mossy territory as Creed Aventus, softer and sweeter.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Fig, Mint, Pineapple
Middle: Jasmine, Sea Salt, Patchouli
Base: Amber, Vanilla, Musk, Moss

Best for

Season: Spring, fall and winter · Wear it: date night, nights out · Time: day or night

item.title: Vantage by Rayhaan – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Rayhaan
Type:
Price: 2.25 - 20.35 (5 variants)

Overview

Vantage by Rayhaan is a woody, spicy incense fragrance, an Eau de Parfum that opens with cardamom, bergamot and pink pepper before a resinous heart of frankincense, myrrh and juniper berries takes over. Cedarwood and patchouli give it a dry, structured finish with a smoky, balsamic glow.

Bold, aromatic and long-wearing, for women and men. Reviewers most often compare it to Amouage Decision, with several calling it a very close alternative.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Cardamom, Bergamot, Pink Pepper
Middle: Frankincense, Myrrh, Juniper Berries
Base: Cedarwood, Patchouli

Best for

Season: Fall and winter · Wear it: date night, special occasions, evenings · Performance: long-lasting

item.title: Equinox by Rayhaan – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Rayhaan
Type:
Price: 2.25 - 20.35 (5 variants)

Overview

Equinox by Rayhaan is a bright, polished white floral, an Eau de Parfum that opens on juicy grapefruit and orange blossom before settling into jasmine sambac and airy white tea. Creamy sandalwood and a soft touch of vanilla warm the dry-down without making it heavy.

Clean, luminous and easy to wear for women and men alike. Its note list matches Maison Mataha Printemps Blanc almost exactly, and retailers widely present it as an alternative to that scent; Rayhaan itself has not confirmed the link.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Grapefruit, Orange Blossom
Middle: Jasmine Sambac, White Tea
Base: Sandalwood, Vanilla

Best for

Season: Spring and summer · Wear it: office, everyday, daytime
